notes.title: Rover Simulator Early Access (PLEASE READ)
notes.notes:
Today is the day Rover Simulator goes live on steam! We just wanted to give an update on the game's current launch as early access, as well as some new features and more about the game's development.

[b]disclaimer[/b]

Since the game is early access, the game is not at its full potential, we have disabled some major features for development, but we are still deciding to release the game early because it will help us with funding to continue development on the game and make it better. There may be some bugs, so we are asking that you report them in our discord or here on steam. https://discord.gg/HysMSgEEnj

Your purchase will directly fund the game and further, its content and development, we still have many things we want to add to the game but we are a small group of developers and could use more community support.

[b]New Features[/b]

[list]
[*]
Random Checkpoint System
New Boundry System
Radar Construction
Overall Optimization
[/list]

Our new checkpoint system, spawns checkpoints randomly around the map, at these checkpoints you will gain XP (research points for when the upgrade system is added), and at some checkpoints, you will find parts/hardware, after you collect 3 parts you can place down a radar by pressing [b]G[/b] This will expand your map boundaries, allowing you to travel further distances and find more checkpoints.

The boundary system limits the distance you can travel on the map, when you go too far out of bounds your rover can lose connection to the satellite, to expand your search area and boundaries, you need to collect parts to construct a radar that can be placed down.

We have fixed many bugs with the game, there still may be more. If you run along with any bugs, issues, or have anything to suggest, please join our discord, https://discord.gg/HysMSgEEnj, or report it on steam.

[b]Future Development Goals[/b]

The future of Rover Simulator is big, we plan to add many more rovers, planets, and features to the game. We plan to add an astronaut that you can play as and land on planets and conduct research. 

We also would like to add a colonization system in the future, this is a big addition to the game but your support and funding for the game now will benefit the future of the game.


Thanks, everyone! Remember join our discord, where you can ask questions and give suggestions, we developers like talking directly to our players. https://discord.gg/HysMSgEEnj

notes.title: Rover Simulator Release News & Beta Applications Open
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, unfortunately, we had to delay our early access release date to sometime in August. But this is actually a good thing, as much as we want to release this game and have players play it, we are taking just a little extra time to refine the game, add more features, and of course test it.

Adding onto that we will be opening beta testing applications within the next few days. We highly encourage you to join our discord, we just opened it and that's where you will hear news and updates about the game first. You also can apply for beta testing there, ask questions, and talk to other people.

https://discord.gg/teD7hjMya2

Just a short announcement but there is more to come!
